scope: Ground access, four wall ascents, upper rail and Pop to Y100 station
method: One controlled initial setup (ground for full route, Y84 for local pilot). Normal R/Shift/Space keys and standard simulated controller movement/look after setup. No direct rail creation, actor/camera assignment, reset or resource injection during route.

cameraSamplePolicy.scope: Actual animated head/hips projection and native static-obstacle triangle rays during normal input, 10Hz at60Hz simulation. No gameplay state writes. Transparent glass below.5alpha excluded from opaque occlusion; moving objects absent from the native obstacle registry, HUD, between-sample frames and physical devices are not certified. Raw samples require context/visual review; collection is not camera acceptance.
